reason: The excavator is packed for transport, so checking how to prepare it is useful before putting it to work.
expectation: The inspection should reveal what can prepare or power the excavator.

alternatives.reason: The excavator will likely need power, but it may need unpacking first.

effect: Steel prepared the excavator with a spoil hopper; it may now need power before use.
reaction: The automatic preparation was useful, though the hopper was not obvious from the packed machine.
reason: The prepared excavator likely needs the available power cable to operate.
expectation: The cable should connect power to the excavator.

alternatives.reason: The excavator might be ready to work at the floor already.

effect: The cable made the excavator operational and revealed the goal of clearing the growing bay.
reaction: The turning drum and spoil hopper make the preparation feel practical.
reason: The working excavator and surveyed cavern floor are the clearest available match for clearing the bay.
expectation: The excavator should clear the surveyed growing bay.

effect: The excavator cleared the surveyed bay and completed the chapter; the cave still needs breathable air.
reaction: The cleared space feels like tangible progress, and the reminder that shelter is not breathable is useful.

mostWorthwhile.text: Clearing the bay was the most worthwhile passage: the marked excavation produced a concrete space for the growing room while distinguishing rock shelter from breathable habitat.

leastWorthwhile.text: Preparing the excavator was less clear than the later actions: steel became a spoil hopper without explaining how it was fitted.

surprise.text: Inspecting the packed excavator automatically combined it with steel and produced a hopper; I had expected compatibility information rather than that specific preparation.

arbitrary.text: The steel-to-hopper preparation felt somewhat arbitrary because the result did not describe the fabrication, although a hopper's purpose became clear when the drum collected spoil.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the cleared cave becomes a growing room; the excavation gave the construction a practical starting point.
